standard_process: Startup source/script/config/meta hashes and dependency inventories were recorded. Per-job metadata assembly failed; this top-level summary is not proof of an automated pin/run/complete closure. A post-run audit corrects interpretations while preserving raw reports and sub-manifests.

publication_audit.scope: Eight generation runs plus one CPU-only quality re-evaluation; no new generation or timing was performed by this audit.
publication_audit.raw_artifacts: Original reports, logs, input hash list, dependency inventories, command note and all three empty child manifests are retained unchanged. The pre-audit top-level manifest is archived separately in the evidence bundle.
publication_audit.metadata_failure: run_pinned.sh passes the output path before tag but unpacks sys.argv[1:9] as tag/backend/locale/batch/...; int(batch) receives en/zh. No per-job meta files are produced. all([]) then labels empty runs as all succeeded. The HF branch also records only the final evaluation return code, not a separate generation return code.
publication_audit.contamination_fields: The original outputs[].contaminated=false values below are retained operator declarations, NOT detector results. GPU start/end snapshots cannot establish continuous isolation. The re-evaluation uses CPU; its contamination field is not applicable to generation GPU isolation.
publication_audit.metric_sources: Use re_evals[0] only for ZH Omni B4 WER/SIM and evaluated count. All generation timing and natural termination remain sourced from the original generation reports/logs.
publication_audit.identity_limits: Startup records are stronger than retrospective reconstruction, but no end-of-run identity check or execution-time reference-audio/weight hash manifest is present. Mutable evaluation model aliases were resolved at runtime.

planned_schedule_note: two fastest (EN omni ~53m + EN hf ~66m) serial on GPU1; ZH omni GPU2; ZH hf GPU7

checkpoint.identity_scope: The launcher hashes config.json, not the weight shards. Revision is operator-confirmed/current-cache evidence, not an enforced model revision argument.

dataset.identity_scope: Startup metadata hashes recorded; reference audio contents were not hashed by this launcher. No immutable upstream dataset revision recovered.

omni.inventory_note: Startup pip-freeze inventory; identical to all three preserved per-process inventories.

hf.inventory_note: Startup pip-list table, 72 packages, not an installable requirements file; identical to all three per-process inventories.

eval_models.pinning_limit: Listed HF revisions are recorded identities, not enforced revision arguments in the evaluator. Paraformer uses mutable master, and WavLM resolves main. Configuration hashes alone do not pin all weights; runtime logs record network/cache resolution.

hardware.startup_observation: Retained CSV shows GPU 1/2/7 at 4 MiB and 0% utilization. Operator reports no compute processes at launch. No continuous occupancy/process trace is retained.

parameters.timing_boundary: Omni times generate() and output sorting; string rendering/reference reads precede its timer and PCM conversion/WAV writes follow it. HF times apply_chat_template, device transfer, generate, synchronization, CPU waveform extraction and stop/duration bookkeeping. Both exclude startup, warmup, reference reads, WAV writes and quality evaluation. Boundaries are not strictly identical.
parameters.launch_command_note: Commands below are abbreviated records, not literal replay commands. Exact shell metadata assembly is defective; archival run_pinned.sh must not be rerun unchanged.

outputs.asr_anomaly: 27 ASR exceptions during Paraformer initialization following proxy/download failures; original WER/SIM covers only 1993 items. Superseded for quality by the full 2020-item CPU re-evaluation. Generation natural_stop=1.0 means 2020/2020; ASR errors do not reduce that count.

end_snapshot_observation: GPU 1/2/7 show 4 MiB / 0% at the end. This does not establish occupancy between the two snapshots; uninterrupted exclusivity remains an operator declaration.

re_evals.type: CPU-only quality re-evaluation of saved generation WAVs (no regeneration)
re_evals.wav_identity_scope: All 2020 current saved WAVs match this re-evaluation hash list. No generation-time WAV hash list is retained, so this is not independent proof of an unbroken historical chain of custody.
re_evals.natural_stop_inherited: 2020/2020 (original generation report natural_stop_rate=1.0; unchanged by re-evaluation)
re_evals.contamination_note: Not applicable to generation GPU occupancy: this re-evaluation runs on CPU and does not validate the original generation isolation.
re_evals.eval_env: Same .venv-test and evaluator code; original evaluation used CUDA, supplement uses CPU (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is empty). Models were resolved from aliases/cache rather than enforced immutable revisions.
re_evals.comparison_with_original: Among the original 1993 successful items, one WER value and 1989 SIM values changed. The supplement replaces the whole quality evaluation, not merely the 27 missing rows. WER rounded to four decimals is 0.0264 -> 0.0263; SIM is 0.8731 -> 0.8731. Device/model-resolution differences preclude attributing all changes solely to filling missing items.
